x-m-el-sta-09.title: Ukwenza igrafu ekhohlisa ngokuphakama kwemigoqo

Bese ukuphakama kwemigoqo okubonakalayo kuba ngu-52−s ku-A no-56−s ku-B. (Uma s=0, ukuphakama okubonakalayo kungu-52 no-56.)

x-m-el-sta-05.title: Ukujikijela okumbalwa nokuningi: inhlanhla noma ukuhlanganisa?
x-m-el-sta-05.goal: Usebenzisa idatha yokulingisa, wahlulele umcabango osemuva kokuhlola ihayipothesisi: nakuba isilinganiso sifana, ukuthi kunzima kangakanani ukuchaza umphumela ngo-'inhlanhla' kuncike enanini lokuzama.
x-m-el-sta-05.material: UJihoon wajikijela uhlamvu lwemali futhi wathi, 'Ngicabanga ukuthi lolu hlamvu lwemali lwenziwe ukuze lehle ngekhanda kaningi!' Usebenzise ikhompyutha ukulingisa ukuthi umphumela onjalo wenzeka kaningi kangakanani ngohlamvu lwemali olufanele (uhlamvu lwemali lapho ikhanda nomsila kunethuba elilinganayo). Imiphumela yokulingisa: (a) Ukujikijela uhlamvu lwemali olufanele izikhathi ezingu-10 kwaphindwa izikhathi ezingu-1000, futhi amakhanda angu-7 noma ngaphezulu avela cishe ku-170 zazo. (b) Ukujikijela uhlamvu lwemali olufanele izikhathi ezingu-100 kwaphindwa izikhathi ezingu-1000, futhi amakhanda angu-70 noma ngaphezulu akazange avele ngisho kanye. Imiphumela yangempela kaJihoon ayiCala A (amakhanda angu-7 ekujikijeleni okungu-10) neCala B (amakhanda angu-70 ekujikijeleni okungu-100).
x-m-el-sta-05.thinking.1: Yahlulela ukuthi inhlanhla ingaluchaza kahle kangakanani umphumela
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.prompt: Obuphi bufakazi obuqinile besimangalo sikaJihoon sokuthi 'uhlamvu lwemali lwenziwe ukuze lehle ngekhanda kaningi'?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.0: Thola ukuthi yiluphi kokulingisa (a) no-(b) Icala A neCala B ngalinye elihambisana nalo.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa, ekulingisweni ngakunye, ukuthi kangaki uhlamvu lwemali olufanele lunikeze nalo umphumela.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.a: Icala A. Ukuthola amakhanda angu-7 ekujikijeleni okuncane yiwo umphumela omangazayo kakhulu
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.a: Ekulingisweni (a), ngisho nohlamvu lwemali olufanele lunikeze amakhanda angu-7 noma ngaphezulu kwangu-10 cishe ku-170 kwangu-1000 yokuzama. Umphumela owenzeka kaningi awumangazi.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.b: Womabili amacala angu-70% wamakhanda, ngakho ubufakazi buqinile ngokulinganayo
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.b: Noma isilinganiso sifana, inani elihlukile lokujikijela lishintsha ukuthi kuyenzeka kangakanani ngenhlanhla. Qhathanisa amathebula okulingisa (a) no-(b).
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.c: Akukho bufakazi. Uhlamvu lwemali olufanele lungehla ngekhanda ngo-70% wesikhathi nalo
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.c: U-'kungenzeka' no-'kwenzeka kaningi' kuhlukile. Ku-(나) kwakungavamile kangangokuthi akuzange kwenzeke ngisho kanye.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.d: Icala B. Umphumela onje akuzange uvele ekulingisweni ngohlamvu lwemali olufanele
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.d: Njengoba inani lokuzama likhula, uthole umphumela onzima ukuwuchaza ngenhlanhla kuphela.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.explain: Ngisho nohlamvu lwemali olufanele, amakhanda angu-7 noma ngaphezulu kwangu-10 enzeka kaningi (cishe 17%), kodwa angu-70 noma ngaphezulu kwangu-100 akazange enzeke ekulingisweni. Noma isilinganiso sifana, ukujikijela okuningi kwenza kube nzima ukuchaza ngenhlanhla. Lona umqondo oyisisekelo wokuhlola ihayipothesisi.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.prompt: Kusukela emphumeleni weCala B, ungaqiniseka ngo-100% ukuthi 'lolu hlamvu lwemali lwenziwe ukuze lehle ngekhanda kaningi'? Bhala isinqumo sakho nesizathu.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.hint.0: Funda umphumela wokulingisa (나), bese ubhala emshweni o-1 ukuthi lowo mphumela usekela kanjani isiphetho sokuthi 'uhlamvu lwemali oluhlinzekiwe.'
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.hint.1: Usebenzisa ukulingisa (b) njengobufakazi, sho ukuthi umphumela onje ungavamile kangakanani ngohlamvu lwemali olufanele.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ingabe isinqumo sakho sisho ukuthi usola kangakanani, kunokuba "ngokuqinisekile hhayi" noma "ngokuqinisekile yebo"?

x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.1: Kunzima ukusho ngokuqinisekile. Ithuba lokuthi uhlamvu lwemali olufanele lunikeze lo mphumela ngenhlanhla alikho u-0. Kodwa akuzange kwenzeke ekulingisweni, ngakho kufanelekile ukusola.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.2: Akuqinisekile ngo-100%. Ukuthola amakhanda angu-70 noma ngaphezulu ekujikijeleni okungu-100 kohlamvu lwemali olufanele akuzange kwenzeke ngisho kanye ekulingisweni okungu-1000, ngakho kuvelakancane ngokwanele ukuvusa ukusola, kodwa ithuba lokuthi iyinhlanhla alikho u-0.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.3: Angikwazi ukusho ukuthi kuqinisekile, kodwa ngumphumela cishe ongavami ngohlamvu lwemali olufanele, ngakho kuyaqagelwa ukuthi uhlamvu lwemali lwehlinzekiwe.
